text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Greetings, Pisa-san.
I have heard all about your exploits. Stupendo!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first day of summer training camp—
Sounds of Earth, a cheerful Umamusume who loves music, came up to talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
For someone like you,
I'd gladly roll up my sleeves and lend a hand today!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Si comincia!
A grand triumphal march just for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The powerful melody played by Sounds of Earth
resonated across the crisp summer sky—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Forza!
May fortune smile upon your Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
I've received such a wonderful boost of energy...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, another fiery summer training camp began!
